g2-c2.title: Null is not a script bug
g2-c2.imperative: Read g2_wide_sigma_ab.py injection code path. Confirm it constructs a NON-EMPTY DriverResidualState with real non-zero residual_mean values derived from lateral_total_grip_g, and threads it into RuntimeModuleContext passed to predict_from_features. Rule out wrong field name / unreached injection point.
g2-c2.finding: Read g2_wide_sigma_ab.py build_driver_residual_state()/run_stage(): constructs DriverResidualStateEntry(residual_mean=lateral_total_grip_g, residual_variance=widened_variance) per resolved driver (20/20 resolved for 2025 Japan, verified real varying values e.g. Ferrari mech=3.7395 total=3.7399, Alpine total=2.8427 -- not placeholders), threads via dataclasses.replace(feature_set.runtime_context, driver_residual_states={'quali': state}) into predict_from_features(runtime_context=...). grep -rn driver_residual_states src/ shows exactly ONE consumer (_make_runtime_driver_residual_history via context.driver_residual_states.get(adapter.task)), and that closure backs only the *_from_residual_history adapters, which are provably absent from every params/gold manifest (g2-c1) and absent from self.modules (top-level manifest 'modules' dict lists only the 12 wired modules) -- so _run_stage's enabled_stage_module_names(stage) loop never reaches it. This is airtight: the field name/threading is correct, the injection point is reached, and the reason for zero effect is structural (module never invoked), not a silent script bug.

g2-c4.title: CPU greater than 0 / issue 623 regression check
g2-c4.imperative: Sanity-check the process-CPU-time polling evidence is a plausible CPU-bound signature (steady ~1x core, not 0 percent) and the 208.9s wall-clock is consistent with ~3-4min per race. Re-run only if in doubt.

CPU evidence in G2_FINDINGS.md/implement-result is internally plausible: injection run shows a steady ~1.03 CPU-s increase per 0.5s wall-clock sample across 6 samples (~full single core, not the 0 percent #623 deadlock signature) and 208.9s total wall-clock matching the prior wave's independently-verified ~3-4min/race reference. g2-c5.title: Sigma-widening formula honestly justified
g2-c5.imperative: Read the exact formula in G2_FINDINGS.md and script docstring; confirm it is not simply copy-pasted from a single views own stored diagonal, should show independence-floor plus explicit inflation-factor reasoning.
